newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends down in thin trade.

text.p: PALMOIL FUTURES PALMOIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,168 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,185 *
Open/hi/low 1,165/1,172/1,160 Prev close 1,185
Prev settlement 1,170 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower after drifting within tight ranges throughout the day. The market was consolidating after sharp gains last week. Trading volume fell sharply after the market posted its heaviest trading session this year on Friday. Jan seen trading in 1,120-1,180 range this week.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Prices were little changed in very thin trading. Trades mostly confined to crude palm oil.
Traders said market players were now focusing on the October crop report from private forecaster Ivan Wong, expected to be released on Thursday.
"Now that the export numbers are out, the market is waiting to see what the stocks are like," another trader said.
Cargo surveyors Caleb Brett and Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) last week estimated October exports at 729,626 and 736,374 tonnes respectively.
Malaysia's palm oil stocks at the end of September were 894,030 tonnes, official Palm Oil Registration and licensing Authority figures showed.
Third position January crude palm oil futures ended down two ringgit at 1,168 ringgit ($462.21) a tonne after trading in a 12 ringgit-range. It rose 52 ringgit last week.
Traders said they expected the contract to trade in the 1,120-1,180 ringgit range this week.
Total turnover on the futures market was 938 lots, down sharply from Friday's 5,966 lots -- the heaviest this year.
Physicals prices were little changed in extremely quiet trading, with trades mostly confined to crude palm oil.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,185 ringgit ($468.94) a tonne with bids at 1,180, after trading between 1,180 and 1,185.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,180 with bids at 1,170, and Nov (north) saw offers at 1,175 and bids at 1,165.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,195 ringgit with bids at 1,185.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,187.50 and bids at 1,175.
Among refined products, Nov RBD palm olein was offered at $540 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $537.50.
Nov/Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $502.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $505. Nov was traded at $500.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $375, Dec at $380 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $390.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $317.50.
